title: 第5章 今生前世张三唐三第6章 新手教程
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
在完成武魂觉醒仪式后，张三和其他人一起回到了他们自己暂住的房间，由于即将返回孤儿院，他必须先将房间里的东西全部理好，以免便宜了下一位进入该房间准备觉醒仪式的家伙。
这段时间来测试和觉醒武魂的孩子的身份都是孤儿，要是被选中的话就是直接前往武魂初级学院进修，所以当张三以及其他孩童来到宿舍暂住，等待武魂殿的觉醒仪式的时候，是把自己所有能带的行李都带来的。
张三的行李中零零散散的物件挺多，整个整理过程比较枯燥，没什么可说道的。
张三就一边给自己的行李打包，一边整理自己的前世记忆。
上一世张三走的就是通过在武魂学院进修，最终正式加入武魂殿的路子，他是变异武魂，又是先天满魂力，武魂殿前期也是认真栽培的。
甚至张三后来还拜了长老殿一个八环魂斗罗为师，一时间也是混得风生水起，有过一段风光的时候。
不过张三幼年并未立即完全觉醒前世作为唐门弟子的记忆，他的前世记忆是以残破片段的形式出现在他的脑子里，想要完全觉醒需要相当多的时间，真正想起他在唐门的全部过往时，他已经二十岁了。
故而张三他在早期就是比一般同龄人心智更成熟些，直到他在三岁时的某一次睡梦中依稀记起了一本名叫《玄天宝录》的功法秘籍，他才练起了玄天功，这时其他的唐门绝学和记忆张三都是不知的。
不过或许也正是因为他很早就修行了玄天功，导致他真实的先天魂力水平被掩盖了。
毕竟这个世界的一般人是不懂武魂觉醒前的修炼方式的，觉醒武魂时的魂力等级，基本看武魂觉醒后给自身的附加魂力，而这个附加魂力才是真实的“先天魂力”。
所以他在往后遇到修炼瓶颈，导致自己进入魂王后魂力难得寸进估计就是因为他本就不是什么真正的修炼天才。
不过就算如此，张三经过刻苦修行仍是成功在二十岁那年进入魂王阶段，这个年纪的魂王放在斗罗大陆，他也算是杰出人才了。
而唐门的其他秘籍包括《暗器百解》《鬼影迷踪》《控鹤擒龙》等，则也是在后面陆续的以记忆片段形式出现在他的脑海中，花时间慢慢吸收消化后才开始修行的。
虽说这也是张三没能在早期利用好唐门绝学闯出一片天地的关键原因，但更关键的是张三的运气真的太差了。
他这边拜的那名魂斗罗老师是前代教皇千寻疾的心腹之一，千寻疾突然重病驾崩后，新教皇比比东登基不久，他这位老师就莫名其妙的在修炼室走火入魔挂了。
张三这下失去了靠山，事后张三也没有再找个新的师父。
毕竟张三这时已经记起了不少唐门的教诲，例如“一日为师终生为父”。
这个师父虽然与自己相处短暂，但生前待自己还算不错，他并不想另投门派。
只是后来武魂殿方面也越来越不待见他，张三深感还是需要一个靠山，就加入了教皇比比东新组建的秘殿。
秘殿是专门听从教皇比比东的差遣的，独立于武魂殿长老殿和斗罗殿外的新组织，换句话说，张三是去抱了教皇的大腿，而且还成为了“最年轻的秘殿成员”。

当然这个头衔并没有什么用，毕竟武魂殿最不缺的就是魂师，你天赋高可以给你增加一些筹码，但修为不行就是不行。而且抱教皇大腿这个看似聪明的举动，也没有让张三平步青云。
比比东教皇这条大腿确实够大，但奈何人家不缺腿部挂件。
鬼、菊两个封号斗罗都甘愿当其马前卒，秘殿里魂帝魂圣都是一抓一大把，他当然没有什么出头的机会。
而且张三虽也为秘殿办事，但他基本没有接到过比比东亲派的任务，甚至平日都没机会和比比东说上一句话，估计这十多年来，比比东也只在名册上见过他的名字，人家能不能把他的名字和脸对上号都很难说。
再加上后来进入魂王后，张三的修为进步缓慢，稍微亮眼的天赋也没了。
之后就基本淡出了武魂殿的大人物们的视野，被重点培养的黄金一代里没他的份。
总的来说，虽然张三开局还算不错，但运气太差了，也没个靠谱的靠山，最后就成了武魂殿一个普普通通的执事。
不过武魂殿究竟是生养自己的地方，而且张三前世也一样就是个寻常的唐门外门弟子，张三最初的愿望也并非当个天下第一的强者，只是想认真赚钱然后娶个好老婆。
同时张三那看似平平无奇的武魂殿执事，本就是个好差事。工作不多，薪酬丰厚，而且只要不犯大错，就相当于铁饭碗，再加上他还有秘殿成员的贴金，所以他就算没有在武魂殿出人头地，一样可以活得很滋润。
然而张三认为自己那还不错的生活，却被一个家伙给打破了。
这个人的身份，相信很多人都已经猜到了……
没错，就是唐三。
张三意识到唐三也来到斗罗大陆，还是在魂师大赛上。
一个叫作史莱克的魂师学院突然在大赛中大放异彩，一路过关斩将，甚至有威胁武魂殿方面的队伍取得优胜的可能。
而在这个学院的参赛成员的名单中，赫然出现了“唐三”二字。
content_en:
After completing the martial soul awakening ceremony, Zhang San and others returned to their temporary room. Since he was about to return to the orphanage, he had to tidy up everything in the room first, so as not to make it easier for the next guy who entered the room to prepare for the awakening ceremony.
The children who came to test and awaken Wuhun during this period were all orphans. If they were selected, they would directly go to Wuhun Junior College for further study. Therefore, when Zhang San and other children came to the dormitory to stay temporarily while waiting for the awakening ceremony of Wuhun Hall, they brought all the luggage they could carry.
There are a lot of scattered items in Zhang San's luggage. The whole sorting process is quite boring and there is nothing to say.
Zhang San packed his luggage and sorted out his past life memories.
In the previous life, Zhang San took the path of furthering his studies at the Wuhun Academy and finally officially joining the Wuhun Palace. He was a mutated martial soul and had innate soul power. The Wuhun Palace also carefully cultivated him in the early stages.
Zhang San later even became a disciple of an Eight-ring Soul Douluo from the Elder Hall, and he was very prosperous for a while.
However, Zhang San did not immediately fully awaken the memory of his previous life as a Tang Sect disciple when he was young. His past life memories appeared in his mind in the form of fragmented fragments. It would take quite a while to fully awaken. By the time he truly remembered his entire past in the Tang Sect, he was already twenty years old.
Therefore, Zhang San was mentally more mature than the average person of the same age in his early years. It was not until he vaguely remembered a secret book of martial arts called "Xuan Tian Bao Lu" in his sleep when he was three years old that he started to practice Xuantian Gong. At this time, Zhang San did not know about other Tang Sect secrets and memories.
However, perhaps it was precisely because he had practiced Xuantian Kung very early that his true level of innate soul power was concealed.
After all, ordinary people in this world do not understand the cultivation methods before the martial soul awakens. The soul power level when the martial soul awakens basically depends on the additional soul power given to oneself after the martial soul awakens, and this additional soul power is the real "innate soul power".
Therefore, when he encountered a bottleneck in his cultivation in the future, it was probably because he was not a true cultivation genius that his soul power hardly improved after he became the Soul King.
But even so, Zhang San succeeded in entering the soul king stage at the age of twenty after hard training. A soul king of this age can be regarded as an outstanding talent in Douluo Continent.
Other secrets of the Tang Sect, including "Hundred Solutions to Hidden Weapons", "Ghost Shadows", "Controlling Cranes and Capturing Dragons", etc., also appeared in his mind in the form of memory fragments later, and he took time to slowly absorb and digest them before he began to practice.
Although this is also the key reason why Zhang San failed to make good use of Tang Sect's unique skills to break into the world in the early stage, the more important reason is that Zhang San's luck is really bad.
The Contra teacher he worshiped here was one of the confidants of the previous Pope Qian Xunji. After Qian Xunji suddenly died of a serious illness and shortly after the new Pope Bibi Dong ascended the throne, his teacher inexplicably went crazy in the training room and died.
Zhang San now lost his backer, and Zhang San did not find a new master afterwards.
After all, Zhang San had already remembered a lot of Tang Sect's teachings, such as "Once a teacher, always a father."
Although he only got along with this master for a short time, he treated him quite well during his lifetime, and he did not want to join another sect.
But later on, the Wuhun Palace also disliked him less and less. Zhang San felt that he still needed a backer, so he joined the newly established Secret Palace of Pope Bibi Dong.
The Secret Palace is a new organization that specifically obeys the orders of Pope Bibi Dong and is independent of the Elder Hall of Wuhun Palace and the Douluo Palace. In other words, Zhang San hugged the Pope's lap and became the "youngest member of the Secret Palace."
Of course, this title is of no use. After all, the most indispensable thing in Wuhun Palace is soul masters. If you are talented, you can gain some leverage, but if you are not good at cultivation, you will not be able to do it. andThe seemingly smart move of hugging the Pope's thigh did not make Zhang San rise to the top.
Pope Bibi Dong’s thighs are indeed big enough, but she does not lack leg accessories.
The two titled Douluo, Gui and Ju, were willing to be their pawns, and there were a lot of Soul Emperors and Soul Saints in the Secret Palace. Of course, he had no chance of getting ahead.
Moreover, although Zhang San also works for the secret palace, he has basically never received any tasks from Bibi Dong, and he has never even had the opportunity to speak to Bibi Dong on weekdays. It is estimated that in the past ten years, Bibi Dong has only seen his name on the roster. It is difficult to say whether others can match his name with his face.
In addition, after entering the Soul King, Zhang San's cultivation progressed slowly, and his slightly dazzling talents were gone.
After that, he basically faded out of the sight of the big shots in Wuhun Palace, and he had no place in the golden generation that was being focused on training.
In general, although Zhang San had a pretty good start, he was very unlucky and did not have a reliable backer. In the end, he became an ordinary deacon of Wuhun Palace.
However, Wuhun Palace is the place where he was born and raised, and Zhang San was an ordinary outer disciple of the Tang Sect in his previous life. Zhang San’s initial wish was not to be the strongest man in the world, but to make money seriously and then marry a good wife.
At the same time, Zhang San’s seemingly ordinary butler of Wuhun Hall is actually a good job. There isn't much work, the salary is generous, and as long as he doesn't make big mistakes, it's like an iron rice bowl. In addition, he has subsidies from members of the Secret Hall, so even if he doesn't get ahead in the Wuhun Hall, he can still live a comfortable life.
However, Zhang San thought that his pretty good life was broken by a guy.
I believe many people have already guessed the identity of this person...
That's right, it's Tang San.
Zhang San realized that Tang San had also come to Douluo Continent, still at the Soul Master Competition.
A soul master academy named Shrek suddenly shined in the competition, passing through all the competition and even threatening the Spirit Hall team to win.
And in the list of participating members of this academy, the word "Tang San" suddenly appeared.
